title: Prototype pollution in deepMerge utility
description: The deepMerge() helper in src/util/merge.js recursively copies keys from a source object into a target without guarding the __proto__ or constructor keys. A source object carrying a __proto__ entry pollutes Object.prototype, affecting every object in the process and letting an attacker bypass property-based checks. Skip __proto__, constructor, and prototype keys when merging.
poc_text: Merge a parsed JSON body whose top-level key is __proto__ and observe the polluted property on an unrelated object.
